title: Almost Heaven | KEY.co
meta_description: Updated home in Seaside | 4-minute walk to beach
description_expanded: The management fees for your booking include access for all members of your party throughout your stay to utilize the facilities of the Seaside Swim and Tennis Club and Fitness Center. You will need to take the passes you will find in your arrival pack for access to each of these facilities each time you use them. There are towels provided at the pools and fitness center and you are asked not to take the guest towels in the bathrooms of the cottages to the pools or fitness center. An hourly use fee for the tennis courts is collected at the tennis pro shop. You may bring your own rackets and balls, or you may rent these at the pro shop. You may also check out basketball, badminton, croquet, shuffleboard, and volleyball accessories if you wish to use any of these facilities as well. Inside, the living room welcomes you with ample seating options and a 72-inch flat-screen TV, perfect for relaxation. The dining room features a farmhouse table with bench seating for eight, illuminated by elegant sea-grass pendants that perfectly complement the coastal style. Additional dining space can be found in the bay window and kitchen bar area. The fully equipped kitchen, complete with a farmhouse sink and floating shelving, invites you to prepare delicious meals with ease. Downstairs, a beautifully renovated half bath boasts stunning shell stone flooring, glass pendant lighting, and a circular mirror.

Features: Coffee maker TV Dryer Washer Internet
